note: d_min=0.04 — lowering d_min worsened MAPE. Late-time tail is flat but the core problem is likely fit_months=316 including zero-production shut-in periods, not terminal decline rate.
d_min=0.07 — higher terminal decline rate improved MAPE significantly. The model with 316 fit months benefits from faster terminal decline to avoid overly optimistic flat forecasts at low rates.

d_min=0.10 — maximum allowed d_min. Steep intra-phase declines and the 316-month fit window with many zero months strongly benefit from higher terminal decline. MAPE improved dramatically 15.50→10.53→4.75 across d_min sweep.
significance_threshold=0.30 — no effect at all, same MAPE and same 316 fit_months. Phase detection unchanged.

significance_threshold=0.75 — filtering insignificant phases improved MAPE substantially. fit_months changed from 316 to 324, and outlier_rejection_rate slightly decreased. The higher threshold helps the model focus on dominant production behavior.
di_initial=0.80 — marginal improvement only (0.0012). The optimizer converges to nearly the same solution regardless of initial guess. di_initial is not impactful for this well.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no effect. The optimizer converges to the same solution regardless of qi initial guess strategy.
b_initial=1.0 — marginally worse. Optimizer converges to similar solution. b_initial not impactful for this well.
